## Smoother under heavy output

- Each terminal now draws on its own thread, so typing, clicking and resizing stay responsive while output pours in. Full-screen floods of output scroll at well over 100 fps, up from single digits in the worst cases.
- The ruler's highlight lane is indexed in the background and no longer freezes the window during floods. It catches up once output calms down.
- Color emoji draw from a cache instead of being rendered again every frame, so screens full of emoji scroll smoothly.
- Less memory churn while highlighting and while rewind captures snapshots of the screen.

## Icons

- 23 generic network and device icons for hosts that aren't any particular brand: patch panels, console servers, VPN concentrators, UPSes, cameras and more, in two new picker sections, Network devices and Devices.
- The Switch icon now looks like a switch. The Wi-Fi icon formerly labelled HPE / Aruba is now called Wireless; searching for HPE or Aruba still finds it, and sessions using either icon keep it.

Choose the x64 download for Intel or AMD PCs. Choose ARM64 only for Windows on ARM devices.
